SANAYİ VE TİCARET A.Ş.

PROTECTION OF PERSONAL DATA (PRIVACY NOTICE)

This Privacy Notice describes how Siskon Endüstriyel Otomasyon Sistemleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. ("Siskon", "we", "us", or "our") collects, stores, uses and shares ("processes") your personal information when you visit our website at www.siskon.com.tr, contact us, apply for a position, or engage with us in other related ways.

1. What information do we collect?

We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide (name, e-mail, phone number, professional data, messages) as well as automatically collected technical data (IP address, log and usage data, device data, cookies).

2. How do we process your information?

We process your personal information to respond to inquiries, perform contracts, evaluate job applications, improve and secure our services, and comply with legal obligations.

3. What legal bases do we rely on?

We process personal data based on explicit consent, performance of contracts, compliance with legal obligations, and legitimate interests under KVKK and GDPR.

4. What are your rights?

Under KVKK Article 11 and GDPR Articles 15-22, you have rights to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, and object to processing. Contact us at kvkk@siskon.com.tr.
